title: CodexOrchestratorCritiqueEvidence
description: Use complete, self-contained sentences for prose and preserve exact file:line or source_id anchors, symbols, commands, and measured numbers. Omit internal codes, working shorthand, and invented labels. Explicitly disclose skipped checks, unverified claims, and unresolved blockers.

summary.description: State the outcome and its evidence in self-contained sentences. Identify skipped checks and unresolved uncertainty.

items.description: State one substantiated strength and the condition under which it holds in a complete sentence.

target_claim.description: Quote or restate the challenged claim in a self-contained sentence.

flaw_type.description: Name the flaw in standard technical terms a reader can understand without internal labels.

counter_argument.description: Explain the counterexample or causal objection in complete sentences.

evidence_or_location.description: Give the exact file:line or source_id anchor, or state the concrete counterexample in a complete sentence.

suggested_fix.description: Describe a concrete correction and the behavior it should produce in a complete sentence.

items.description: Describe an omitted alternative and why it warrants consideration in a complete sentence.
Name the assumption or skipped check and explain what evidence is missing in a complete sentence.

option.description: Identify the actual option by a descriptive name a reader can recognize without an internal label.

pros.description: Explain the option’s advantages and their conditions in complete sentences.

cons.description: Explain the option’s drawbacks or unresolved risks in complete sentences.
